subject: Promotion packet: committee exception & redaction workflow for Rohan Mehta
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Promotion packet: committee exception & redaction workflow for Rohan Mehta

Hi team —

I'm preparing Rohan Mehta's level-change packet for the June committee window. Two things I want to flag early so we can avoid last-minute friction:

1) Executive exception request: Rohan's case will ask for an exception to the usual comp band because the role scope changed mid-cycle (added cross-product ownership). I'll attach a short justification and the updated comp ask. I want to route the exception to Markus for signoff before we publish the packet to the committee.

2) Sensitive evidence: Rohan included snippets from a partner contract and a customer email that must be redacted for confidentiality. I drafted redaction instructions (attached) but need alignment on who will do the redaction and confirm the final redacted PDF that goes to committee.

Ask: can Markus confirm if he is comfortable approving the exception? Lauren — can you own the redaction (or delegate to someone on Talent Ops) and share the redacted packet back to me by Wednesday EOD? Aditya — please confirm if comp approvals are needed from Finance ahead of committee so I can include the approvals sheet.

Attachments: RMehta_promotion_writeup_v2.pdf, redaction_instructions.txt, comp_approvals_2027_Q2.xlsx

Thanks —
Mina
Sr. Eng Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Promotion packet: committee exception & redaction workflow for Rohan Mehta

Thanks for the heads-up, Mina.

I reviewed the justification in the writeup. I'm willing to approve the executive exception in principle, but I want a one-paragraph summary of the business impact (quantified where possible) to attach to the exception request. Can you add that to the writeup? Once that's in, I will sign off and route to Finance as needed.

Lauren — please confirm ownership of the redaction plan. If you need a temp to perform the redaction, we can ask Talent Ops to assign Aisha for a quick pass.

Markus

I'll take point on the redaction.

Plan: I'll perform an initial redaction pass this afternoon using the instructions Mina attached and produce two artifacts — (1) redacted PDF for committee circulation, (2) a second PDF that keeps the evidence intact for HR-only review (watermarked and access-restricted).

If sensitive contract language is involved, I will also send the excerpts to Legal for a quick confirm. Aisha in Talent Ops can stand up the redaction if my calendar blocks; I'll loop her if necessary.

Mina — I expect to have the redacted committee packet back to you by Wed 5pm PT.

Appreciate the quick responses. Updates below —

- I've added a one-paragraph business-impact note to the top of the writeup (see attached V3). It calls out the cross-product ownership, the projected revenue deflection, and the critical delivery in Q4. Markus — please confirm and I'll mark the exception as ready for your signature.

- Lauren: thank you. Please route any legal questions to LegalOps-urgent; if they require redaction changes we'll iterate but keep the committee packet schedule intact.

- Aditya: Finance confirmation not required pre-committee for the ask level we discussed, but if the committee approves we'll run the comp approvals immediately after. Still attaching comp_approvals_2027_Q2.xlsx for visibility.

Next steps: Markus to sign exception by Friday EOD; Lauren to return redacted packet Wed 5pm; I will upload final artifacts to the Drive folder and submit to the committee by Thu morning.

Attachments: RMehta_promotion_writeup_v3.pdf, redaction_instructions.txt, comp_approvals_2027_Q2.xlsx

Mina
